title: Lump Sum Put Forward on a Compromise Offer — Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery Measure
content:
**Clause.** The lump sum a compromise offer puts forward on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** is the monthly amount VA recovers on the debt multiplied by the longest plan approved with a Financial Status Report, less the standard cost of collection of 5 percent, taken at the standard rate of 100 percent, never more than the outstanding balance, and rounded to the cent. The monthly amount VA recovers is the approved reduced withholding or plan installment recorded on the debt, or, where none is recorded, the smallest plan installment of the debt type.

## Definitions

- **Monthly amount** — the approved monthly withholding or monthly installment of the reduced withholding or repayment plan recorded on the debt; where the debt shows no plan method or a monthly amount of zero, the smallest plan installment of the debt type.
- **Recovery** — the monthly amount multiplied by the longest plan approved with a Financial Status Report for the debt type, in months.
- **Cost of collection** — 5 percent of the recovery, taken off the recovery.
- **Rate** — what remains is multiplied by 100 percent.
- **Limit** — the figure is limited to the outstanding balance on the debt record.
- **Rounding** — to the cent, only at the end.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

An approved reduced withholding of 96.60 USD recorded on a debt, a hypothetical longest plan with a report of 60 months, an outstanding balance of 8,000.00 USD:

| Stage | Figure |
|---|---|
| Recovery: 96.60 multiplied by 60 | 5,796.00 USD |
| Less 5 percent of it (289.80 USD) | 5,506.20 USD |
| At 100 percent | 5,506.20 USD |
| Limited to the 8,000.00 USD balance | 5,506.20 USD |
| Lump sum | 5,506.20 USD |

With an outstanding balance of 4,000.00 USD instead, the lump sum is limited to 4,000.00 USD.
